quam actualis flexio. 4. Nullo modo sequitur
Deum determinare voluntatem ad peccatum,
quia ad actum determinet, non magis quam
sequitur, Deus coefficit collaterali influxu
actum peccati. Ex Arminianus, ergo est coef-
ficiens causa peccati: nam tam firma est haec,
quam illa sequela, neque sequitur Deum esse
authorem peccati, quia determinat ad actum
propter eandem rationem, sed quoniam ex
Arminianis Deus generali influxu concurrit ad
omnes actus liberos, ita ut ex Deo non sit,
quod actus potius sit bonus quam malus, o-
ptime sequitur eodem modo Deum esse au-
thorem peccati, quo est boni, ex Arminia-

page.notes: The scan shows a small printed mark ("2"-like sign) in the right margin beside the line "nis placitis." It is probably a printer's section mark and is not transcribed as text. The word "omninò" is read as "omnino" and "Patre" as "Patre"; both are slightly uncertain. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout (printed "f" in "ftatuta", "fed", "ipfa", "Chriftum" etc.). The text ends with the hyphenated "con-", and the catchword "filium" is set at the foot.
